mapper.select: SELECT id, exam_attempt_id, paper_question_id, answer_content, is_correct, score, actual_score, answered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_answer WHERE exam_attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY paper_question_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_answer (exam_attempt_id, paper_question_id, answer_content, is_correct, score, actual_score, answered_at) VALUES (#{examAttemptId}, #{paperQuestionId}, #{answerContent}, NULL, #{score}, NULL, #{answeredAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answer_content = VALUES(answer_content), is_correct = NULL, score = VALUES(score), actual_score = NULL, answered_at = VALUES(answered_at)
